standard_prerequisites.name: Permanence under etale surjection
standard_prerequisites.use: Transfers the bound to all etale morphisms into X.

core_obligations: The scheme U -> X is surjective etale with universally bounded fibres over X.
Any etale V -> X pulls back to a quasi-compact separated locally quasi-finite V x_X U -> V over the scheme V; its fibres are bounded.
The permanence lemma transfers the bound from the covering U to V itself; conclude reasonableness.
proof_roadmap: Bounded cover; pullback boundedness; permanence finish.
difficulty_reason: A two-lemma transfer; the pullback step carries the content.
